p.i: Exilijs vagus huc illuc fluctantibus errans Iudæus.

main_text.p: Libros utriusque Instrumenti singulos, sive Historicos, sive Propheticos, sive Dogmaticos adorti varij, ut vix ullus protervorum hominum tela & scommata declinarit. Ex Paganis, Danielem imprimis Porphyrius; ex Iudæis, Iobum, Ecclesiastem, Proverbia, Talmudistarum quidam; ex hæreticis in Christianâ Ecclesiâ bene multi, alij alios repudiavêre Canonicos; Legem Mosis traduxisse fertur Ptolomæus ille, Valentini Æonum in felicissimi parentis progenies; Prophetas Theodorus Mopsuestenus, post mortem etiam cum Origine Adamantio anathematizatus in Concilio Constantinopolitano II. seu Oecumenico V; Psalmos Gnostici & Nicolaitæ; Salomonis monumenta ex veteribus, imò recentioribus è Socini potissimum schola, varij; Evangelia solo Matthæo

page.notes: The text is set in mixed roman and italic, with black letter absent. The italic runs were judged from the scan and may be off at a few word boundaries. The verse line is printed as two lines and is kept as one paragraph. The catchword "thæo" is the first word of the next page. The paragraph continues across the whole page, with no indent after the first line. The word "Constantinopolitano" and the Roman numerals "II." and "V" are read as printed.
